name: Differentiable Direct Volume Rendering (DiffDVR)
definition: A differentiable volume rendering solution that provides differentiability of all continuous parameters of the volume rendering process, enabling optimization of external parameters (camera, transfer function, integration stepsize) and the volumetric scalar field itself via gradient descent on a problem-specific objective function.
summary: DiffDVR optimizes volume rendering parameters by using analytic inversion to compute gradients, reducing memory usage to O(n) while accounting for ray-based occlusion effects.
